findings: contextbridge/graph.json is not valid JSON (Extra data: line 47 column 1 (char 835)); fix or delete it
disagreements.explained: The random 'edit' step appended text to a notes file under contextbridge/ that an earlier `git add -A` had committed. The tool correctly returned BLOCKED (corrupt notes); the oracle only checks that state.json exists. Harness artifact, not a tool bug. Later seeds exclude the notes from edit targets.

tokens.tokenizers: cl100k_base and o200k_base (tiktoken) are proxies; Claude's tokenizer is not available offline. est = UTF-8 bytes / 4.

findings.title: Concurrent writers silently lose evidence
findings.evidence: 8 parallel writers ran 40 test runs; only 5 were recorded (35 lost). state.json always stayed valid JSON because writes are atomic.
findings.fix: Lock the read-modify-write of the state files (flock on POSIX, msvcrt on Windows) and reload before each save.

findings.title: A malformed state.json crashes `resume` instead of returning BLOCKED
findings.evidence: A state.json containing a JSON list produced a Python traceback (AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'get') rather than a BLOCKED verdict.
findings.fix: Validate that the top level is an object when loading and route anything else to the existing 'not valid' BLOCKED path.

findings.title: Gate output is unbounded when many files change
findings.evidence: 1,000 new untracked files produced 1,000 findings, about 15,052 tokens for `resume --check`. Typical runs are a median 65 tokens.
findings.fix: Summarize repeated findings: show the first few and a count, as the gate already does for unverified claims.

findings.title: `git stash -u` and `git clean -fd` delete untracked notes
findings.evidence: Both commands removed the untracked contextbridge/ folder; the gate then correctly returned BLOCKED (no checkpoint). With `init --local-only` the notes survived both.
findings.fix: Document it and recommend `init --local-only` or committing the notes.

findings.title: The generic secret rule flags ordinary code
findings.evidence: 24 lines flagged in 979,577 lines of Python stdlib (25 per million) and 59 in sampled JavaScript (78 per million), for example `token = self._fp.read(1)[0]`.
findings.fix: Ignore right-hand sides that are calls or attribute lookups; keep the rule strict for quoted literals.

findings.title: Scanner has no pattern for several common key formats
findings.evidence: 9 of 9 uncovered formats (Telegram, Shopify, DigitalOcean, Mailchimp, bare hex and base64 secrets…) are never flagged, by design for the entropy-only ones.
findings.fix: Add dedicated patterns for vendor-prefixed formats; keep the best-effort wording.
